# Build and Release Guide

This guide applies to `kawaikara/dev3`.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 22 or newer.
- pnpm 10 or newer. The repository pins pnpm `10.33.0` in `package.json`.
- The local KawaiUI package expected by `@kawaikara/kawai-ui: link:../../KawaiUi`.
- Platform tools required by electron-builder for the target operating system.
- Castlabs EVS access for Widevine VMP-signed distributable builds.

Install workspace dependencies:

```bash
pnpm install
```

The app uses Castlabs Electron `35.2.2+wvcus`. At runtime, startup waits for the Widevine component before creating the viewer so DRM sites do not race CDM installation.

## Environment file

Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill the Castlabs credentials when packaging DRM-capable builds:

```dotenv
KAWAIKARA_EVS_ACCOUNT=your-castlabs-account
KAWAIKARA_EVS_PASSWORD="your-castlabs-password"
```

Optional variables select a Conda environment or Python executable for EVS. `.env.local` is private and must not be committed.

Both account and password must be present together. Packaging scripts reject a half-configured credential pair.

## Development commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm dev` | Build packages/app in development mode and start Electron |
| `pnpm build:packages` | Build `site-api`, then `builtin-sites` |
| `pnpm build:app` | Production webpack build for Main, Preload, and Renderer |
| `pnpm build` | Build workspace packages and the production app bundle |
| `pnpm start` | Build and launch Electron |
| `pnpm typecheck` | Type-check packages, app, and Storybook |

Webpack emits:

```text
dist/
├── main/main.js
├── preload/
│   ├── preload.js
│   └── viewer.js
└── renderer/
    ├── index.html + overlay.js
    ├── video.html + video.js
    └── external-login.html + external-login.js
```

Build-time constants include the release channel and optional Discord application ID. Set `DISCORD_APP_ID` before building to enable Discord Rich Presence; an empty value disables it without failing startup.

## Storybook

Run the app-owned view and component catalog without Electron:

```bash
pnpm storybook
```

Storybook listens on port `6006`, loads KawaiUI and renderer styles, and installs `stories/Mocks/KawaikaraMock.ts` before each story. Stories currently cover Menu, Preference, Video, developer links, external-login status, PiP controls, site menu controls, and the downloader panel.

Create a static Storybook build with:

```bash
pnpm storybook:build
```

## Development package

```bash
pnpm package:dev
```

The script:

1. Requires the current `Kawaikara Dev` application to be stopped on macOS.
2. Authenticates EVS when credentials are configured.
3. Runs the development build.
4. Packages the current platform/architecture through `electron-builder.dev.config.cjs`.
5. Replaces the managed output atomically and restores the previous build if packaging fails.
6. On macOS, opens the packaged application once so Launch Services registers `kawaikara://`.

Development output is placed below:

```text
builds/dev/<os>/<arch>/
```

The development package uses app ID `day.faby.kawaikara.dev` and product name `Kawaikara Dev`. macOS certificate auto-discovery is disabled for this local package, but Widevine VMP signing still runs when `KAWAIKARA_VMP_SIGN=1`.

Verify the package signature and Widevine VMP state with:

```bash
pnpm widevine:verify
```

Authenticate EVS explicitly with:

```bash
pnpm widevine:auth
```

## Release channels

Kawaikara has three build/update channels:

| Build channel | Version shape | Updater channel | GitHub release type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Stable | `3.0.0` | `latest` | Release |
| Staging | `3.0.0-staging.N` | `staging` | Prerelease |
| Nightly | `3.0.0-nightly.N` | `nightly` | Prerelease |

The package script temporarily changes `package.json` to the calculated release version, builds/packages, and restores the original file in a `finally` block.

The build number defaults to `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER`, or `0` outside CI. `KAWAIKARA_RELEASE_VERSION` can supply an explicit valid version. `release:auto` infers the channel from a `v`-prefixed tag:

- `v3.0.0` -> Stable.
- `v3.0.0-staging.42` -> Staging.
- `v3.0.0-nightly.42` -> Nightly.

Stable versions may not contain a prerelease suffix. Staging and Nightly versions must begin with their corresponding prerelease name.

## Build-only and publish commands

| Channel | Build without publishing | Build and publish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stable | `pnpm dist:stable` | `pnpm release:stable` |
| Staging | `pnpm dist:staging` | `pnpm release:staging` |
| Nightly | `pnpm dist:nightly` | `pnpm release:nightly` |

Automatic tag-based publishing:

```bash
pnpm release:auto
```

All channel packaging commands set `KAWAIKARA_VMP_SIGN=1`, authenticate EVS when credentials are available, run the full build, and invoke electron-builder.

## Platform artifacts

Release output is grouped by channel and operating system:

```text
builds/<channel>/<os>/
```

Configured targets are:

- macOS: DMG and ZIP for x64 and arm64.
- Windows: NSIS installer and ZIP for x64.
- Linux: AppImage for x64 and arm64.

The artifact name includes product, version, channel, OS, architecture, and extension. The application registers the `kawaikara://` protocol.

## Update behavior

`electron-updater` is configured with automatic download and automatic install-on-quit disabled. Automatic update checks are also disabled by default in Preferences.

When automatic checks are enabled, app startup checks the selected channel. A found update displays a localized confirmation before download, shows progress on application windows, and asks again before restart/install. Manual checks use the same channel and result reporting from App Info.

Nightly builds force the Nightly updater channel. Stable and Staging builds can persist a selected channel. Update checks return `unsupported` in a non-packaged development run.

## Discord presence

If `DISCORD_APP_ID` was embedded during webpack build and a Discord client is available, startup publishes Kawaikara Rich Presence with project/Discord buttons and configured image asset keys. Failure to connect is non-fatal, and shutdown clears/destroys the client.

## Pre-release checklist

- `pnpm typecheck` succeeds.
- `pnpm storybook:build` succeeds.
- `pnpm build` succeeds from a clean dependency install.
- The packaged build passes `pnpm widevine:verify`.
- DRM playback is tested with isolated site profiles.
- Login popup and external-browser flows are tested with a real account.
- Unified PiP enters, moves, resizes, and restores focus on landscape and portrait video.
- File drop and HLS playback work in the internal Video view.
- The release version matches its channel rules.
- GitHub updater metadata and all intended artifacts are present before publishing to users.
